service.description:
BIA (Business Impact Analysis) continuity check: for a DeviceGroup (a zone, a panel, or a controller-scoped sub-plant - see the device-group-zone-modeling skill), determine for each DeviceGroupMember whether losing that device stops the group. criticalityEnumId (moqui-cybersecurity-agent's extend-entity on DeviceGroupMember) is the signal: absent or DgmcEssential means the member is a single point of failure for the group (GROUP_STOPS); DgmcRedundant/DgmcStandby/DgmcNonEssential mean the group keeps functioning without it (GROUP_CONTINUES). Deliberately not inferred from purposeEnumId or from duplicate purposeEnumId values within the group - two members can share the same functional purpose without being redundant for each other (e.g. two drives each driving a different actuator: losing either one is still critical).
This is a MmtCodeDefinedFunction MathModel (MM_DEVICE_GROUP_CONTINUITY, see CyberMachineGraphMetadataSeedData.xml), following the same math-model-run-tracking pattern as check#ProductCategoryCompliance: every call is logged as a moqui.math.MathModelRun.

System-level norm-to-zone crosswalk: the DeviceGroup counterpart of check#ProductCategoryCompliance, for norm content that is explicitly control-SYSTEM scoped rather than component/Product scoped (IEC 62443-3-3's baseline System Requirements, verified via the norm's own clause 4.1 - "the control system SRs" - not assumed). Resolves the DeviceGroup's applicable requirement group(s) via CyberDeviceGroupNormRequirementAppl (not ProductCategoryMember/ find#ProductFeatureGroups - a DeviceGroup is not a mantle.product.Product), then for each ProductFeature in those groups reports one of three honest statuses: - SATISFIED / MISSING: only for the 2 requirements (SR 5.1 Network segmentation, SR 5.2 Zone boundary protection) that have a real, already-modeled structural evidence signal in this project - a DeviceGroupMember with purposeEnumId=DgmpZoneBoundary (the conduit/boundary-device pattern from the device-group-zone-modeling skill). - NoEvidenceSchema: every other requirement - honestly reported as not automatically evaluable, since no real evidence entity/data exists yet for it (e.g. account management, audit logging, session control) - never guessed as SATISFIED or fabricated as MISSING. Same discipline already applied to CyberDeviceAccount/ CyberDeviceCommunicationFlow being schema-ready-but-empty.
This is a MmtCodeDefinedFunction MathModel (MM_DEVICE_GROUP_NORM_COMPLIANCE, see CyberMachineGraphMetadataSeedData.xml): every call is logged as a moqui.math.MathModelRun.
